description: This file defines the enum `CreditAllocationTransactionType` which associates specific loan transaction types with human-readable names and provides a method to retrieve these as a list of `EnumOptionData` objects.

classes.name: CreditAllocationTransactionType
classes.description: An enum representing different types of credit allocation transactions, currently includes CHARGEBACK.

methods.name: getValuesAsEnumOptionDataList
methods.description: Returns a list of `EnumOptionData` objects corresponding to each enum constant, facilitating UI dropdowns or similar selections.
